        },
        "contents": "export class PublicKnowledgeController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件（用于直接访问）\n   * 注意：这个路由实际上由静态文件服务处理，但保留作为备用\n   */\n  async getFile(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const filename = req.params.filename;\n      const filePath = require('path').join(publicKnowledgeService.getUploadDir(), filename);\n\n      if (!require('fs').existsSync(filePath)) {\n        return res.status(404).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '文件不存在'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const fileStream = require('fs').createReadStream(filePath);\n      fileStream.pipe(res);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取文件失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '获取文件失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport const publicKnowledgeController = new PublicKnowledgeController();",

          {

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages = async \n\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响用户体验\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles();\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setPublicKnowledgeFiles(response.data);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载公共知识库文件失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 更新已配置的资源清单\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 区分文件来源和互联网信息点\n    // 文件来源：通过文件上传功能上传的文件（URL是文件路径，不是http链接）\n    // 互联网信息点：来自\"检索信息\"模块的来源（排除上传的文件，只包含http/https链接或没有URL的文本来源）\n    const files = sources.filter(s =&gt; {\n      // 文件上传的通常URL是文件路径，不是http链接\n      // 检查：type为external，且有url，且url不是http/https开头\n      // 文件URL特征：以/uploads/开头，或者包含文件扩展名（.pdf, .doc等）\n      \n      // 首先检查type\n      if (s.type !== 'external') {\n        return false;\n      }\n      \n      // 检查URL是否存在\n      const hasUrl = s.url &amp;&amp; (typeof s.url === 'string' || typeof s.url === 'object');\n      if (!hasUrl) {\n        console.log('[资源清单] ✗ 未识别为文件（无URL）:', { \n          id: s.id, \n          title: s.title, \n          type: s.type,\n          url: s.url,\n          urlType: typeof s.url\n        });\n        return false;\n      }\n      \n      // 处理URL（可能是字符串或对象）\n      let urlStr: string;\n      if (typeof s.url === 'string') {\n        urlStr = s.url.trim();\n      } else if (s.url &amp;&amp; typeof s.url === 'object' &amp;&amp; 'toString' in s.url) {\n        urlStr = String(s.url).trim();\n      } else {\n        console.log('[资源清单] ✗ 未识别为文件（URL格式异常）:', { \n          id: s.id, \n          title: s.title, \n          type: s.type,\n          url: s.url,\n          urlType: typeof s.url\n        });\n        return false;\n      }\n      \n      if (urlStr.length === 0) {\n        return false;\n      }\n    };\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "export class PublicKnowledgeController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 上传文件\n   */\n  async uploadFile(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const uploadMiddleware = upload.single('file');\n      \n      uploadMiddleware(req, res, async (err) =&gt; {\n        if (err) {\n          logger.error('文件上传失败:', err);\n          return res.status(400).json({\n            success: false,\n            message: err.message || '文件上传失败'\n          });\n        }\n\n        if (!req.file) {\n          return res.status(400).json({\n            success: false,\n            message: '未选择文件'\n          });\n        }\n\n        try {\n          const { category_id, description, uploaded_by } = req.body;\n          const categoryId = category_id !== undefined \n            ? (category_id === 'null' || category_id === null ? null : parseInt(category_id))\n            : undefined;\n          const uploadedBy = uploaded_by ? parseInt(uploaded_by) : undefined;\n\n          const file = await publicKnowledgeService.saveUploadedFile(\n            req.file,\n            categoryId,\n            description,\n            uploadedBy\n          );\n\n          res.status(201).json({\n            success: true,\n            data: file,\n            message: '文件上传成功'\n          });\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error('保存文件失败:', error);\n          res.status(500).json({\n            success: false,\n            message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '保存文件失败'\n          });\n        }\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('上传文件失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '上传文件失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新文件\n   */\n  async updateFile(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class PublicKnowledgeController {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 下载文件\n   */\n  async downloadFile(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的文件ID'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const { stream, file } = await publicKnowledgeService.getFileStream(id);\n\n      res.setHeader('Content-Type', file.file_type);\n      res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', &#96;attachment; filename=\"${encodeURIComponent(file.name)}\"&#96;);\n      res.setHeader('Content-Length', file.file_size);\n\n      stream.pipe(res);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('下载文件失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '下载文件失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件（用于直接访问）\n   * 注意：这个路由实际上由静态文件服务处理，但保留作为备用\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "const PublicKnowledgePage: React.FC = \n\n\n  // 删除分类\n  const handleDeleteCategory = async (id: number) =&gt; {\n    if (!confirm('确定要删除这个分类吗？删除后，该分类下的所有子分类和文件也将被删除。')) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.deleteCategory(id);\n      if (response.success) {\n        toast.success('分类删除成功');\n        await loadCategories();\n        if (selectedCategoryId === id) {\n          setSelectedCategoryId(null);\n        }\n        await loadFiles(selectedCategoryId === id ? null : selectedCategoryId);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '删除分类失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('删除分类失败:', error);\n      toast.error('删除分类失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 上传文件\n  const handleUploadFile = async (file: File, data?: CreateFileDTO) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.uploadFile(file, {\n        ...data,\n        category_id: selectedCategoryId,\n      });\n      if (response.success) {\n        toast.success('文件上传成功');\n        setShowUploadModal(false);\n        await loadFiles(selectedCategoryId);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '文件上传失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('文件上传失败:', error);\n      toast.error('文件上传失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 删除文件\n  const handleDeleteFile = async (id: number) =&gt; {\n    if (!confirm('确定要删除这个文件吗？')) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.deleteFile(id);\n      if (response.success) {\n        toast.success('文件删除成功');\n        await loadFiles(selectedCategoryId);\n      } else {\n        toast.error(response.message || '删除文件失败');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('删除文件失败:', error);\n      toast.error('删除文件失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen bg-gray-50\"&gt;\n;",

        "contents": "export class PublicKnowledgeService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 保存上传的文件\n   */\n  async saveUploadedFile(file: Express.Multer.File, categoryId?: number | null, description?: string, uploadedBy?: number): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try {\n      const filePath = this.generateFilePath(file.originalname);\n      \n      // 确保目录存在\n      const dir = path.dirname(filePath);\n      if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {\n        fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });\n      }\n\n      // 移动文件到目标位置\n      fs.writeFileSync(filePath, file.buffer);\n\n      // 创建文件记录\n      const fileData: CreateFileDTO = {\n        category_id: categoryId ?? null,\n        name: file.originalname,\n        file_path: filePath,\n        file_type: file.mimetype,\n        file_size: file.size,\n        description: description,\n        uploaded_by: uploadedBy\n      };\n\n      const fileRecord = await publicKnowledgeModel.createFile(fileData);\n      \n      logger.info('文件上传成功', {\n        fileId: fileRecord.id,\n        fileName: file.originalname,\n        filePath: filePath\n      });\n\n      return {\n        ...fileRecord,\n        file_url: this.getFileUrl(filePath)\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('保存上传文件失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除文件（包括物理文件）\n   */\n  async deleteFileWithPhysicalFile(fileId: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n() =&gt; {\n\n    \n    const internetInfo = sources.filter(s =&gt; {\n      // 排除上传的文件（URL是文件路径的）\n      const hasUrl = s.url &amp;&amp; typeof s.url === 'string' &amp;&amp; s.url.trim().length &gt; 0;\n      if (!hasUrl) {\n        // 没有URL的文本来源，需要检查是否是对话摘要或技术转译\n        const category = getCategory(s);\n        if (category === 'ai-qa-summary' || category === 'technical-translation') {\n          return false; // 排除对话摘要和技术转译\n        }\n        return true; // 没有URL且不是对话摘要/技术转译的，归类为互联网信息\n      }\n      \n      const urlStr = s.url.trim();\n      const isHttpUrl = urlStr.startsWith('http://') || urlStr.startsWith('https://');\n      const isFileUrl = !isHttpUrl &amp;&amp; (\n        urlStr.startsWith('/uploads/') || \n        urlStr.startsWith('uploads/') ||\n        /\\.(pdf|doc|docx|txt|md|jpg|jpeg|png|gif|webp|ppt|pptx)$/i.test(urlStr)\n      );\n      \n      if (isFileUrl) {\n        return false; // 排除文件\n      }\n      \n      // 排除对话摘要和技术转译（这些应该显示在历史记录中，而不是互联网信息点）\n      const category = getCategory(s);\n      if (category === 'ai-qa-summary' || category === 'technical-translation') {\n        return false; // 排除对话摘要和技术转译\n      }\n      \n      // 包含http/https链接的来源，或者没有URL的文本来源（通过检索信息添加的）\n      return true;\n    });\n    \n    // 将公共知识库文件（type: 'knowledge_base'）转换为知识点格式\n    const publicKnowledgeSources = sources.filter(s =&gt; s.type === 'knowledge_base');\n    const publicKnowledgeAsPoints: KnowledgePoint[] = publicKnowledgeSources.map(source =&gt; ({\n      id: source.id,\n      tech_point_id: 0,\n);\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "const UploadModal: React.FC&lt;UploadModalProps&gt; = ({\n  onClose,\n  onUpload,\n  selectedCategoryId,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const [file, setFile] = useState&lt;File | null&gt;(null);\n  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');\n  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);\n  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);\n  const fileInputRef = useRef&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;(null);\n\n  const handleFileSelect = (selectedFile: File) =&gt; {\n    setFile(selectedFile);\n  };\n\n  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setIsDragging(true);\n  };\n\n  const handleDragLeave = (e: React.DragEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setIsDragging(false);\n  };\n\n  const handleDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setIsDragging(false);\n\n    const droppedFile = e.dataTransfer.files[0];\n    if (droppedFile) {\n      handleFileSelect(droppedFile);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleFileInputChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;) =&gt;         "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \n\n              &lt;div\n                className=\"border-2 border-dashed border-gray-300 rounded-lg p-8 text-center hover:border-gray-400 transition-colors cursor-pointer\"\n                onClick={() =&gt; {\n                  e.currentTarget.classList.remove('border-blue-500');\n                }}\n                onDrop={async (e) =&gt; {\n                  e.preventDefault();\n                  e.currentTarget.classList.remove('border-blue-500');\n                  await handleFileUpload(e.dataTransfer.files);\n                  // 上传完成后再关闭弹窗\n                  setShowFileUploadModal(false);\n                }}\n              &gt;\n                &lt;Upload className=\"w-12 h-12 text-gray-400 mx-auto mb-4\" /&gt;\n                &lt;p className=\"text-gray-600 mb-2\"&gt;\n                  点击或拖拽文件到此处上传\n                &lt;/p&gt;\n                &lt;p className=\"text-sm text-gray-500\"&gt;\n                  支持 PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT, MD, 图片等格式\n                &lt;/p&gt;\n                &lt;input\n                  ref={fileInputRefModal}\n                  type=\"file\"\n                  multiple\n                  className=\"hidden\"\n                  onChange={async (e) =&gt; {\n                    await handleFileUpload(e.target.files);\n                    // 上传完成后再关闭弹窗\n                    setShowFileUploadModal(false);\n                  }}\n                  accept=\".pdf,.doc,.docx,.txt,.md,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.gif,.webp\"\n                /&gt;\n              &lt;/div&gt;\n              {isUploading &amp;&amp; (\n                &lt;div className=\"mt-4 text-center text-sm text-gray-500\"&gt;\n                  上传中...\n                &lt;/div&gt;\n              )}\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n\n            {/* 弹窗底部 */}\n            &lt;div className=\"flex items-center justify-end space-x-3 p-6 border-t border-gray-200\"&gt;\n              &lt;button\n                onClick={() =&gt;         "contents": "const FileList: React.FC&lt;FileListProps&gt; = ({\n  files,\n  selectedCategoryId,\n  onDeleteFile,\n  loading,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState&lt;'grid' | 'list'&gt;('grid');\n  const [previewFile, setPreviewFile] = useState&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile | null&gt;(null);\n\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&gt; {\n    if (bytes === 0) return '0 B';\n    const k = 1024;\n    const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];\n    const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));\n    return Math.round(bytes / Math.pow(k, i) * 100) / 100 + ' ' + sizes[i];\n  };\n\n  const getFileIcon = (fileType: string) =&gt; {\n    if (fileType.startsWith('image/')) {\n      return '🖼️';\n    } else if (fileType.includes('pdf')) {\n      return '📄';\n    } else if (fileType.includes('word') || fileType.includes('document')) {\n      return '📝';\n    } else if (fileType.includes('excel') || fileType.includes('spreadsheet')) {\n      return '📊';\n    } else if (fileType.includes('powerpoint') || fileType.includes('presentation')) {\n      return '📽️';\n    } else if (fileType.includes('zip') || fileType.includes('rar')) {\n      return '📦';\n    } else {\n      return '📎';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDownload = async (file: PublicKnowledgeFile) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const blob = await publicKnowledgeService.downloadFile(file.id);\n      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n      const a = document.createElement('a');\n      a.href = url;\n      a.download = file.name;\n      document.body.appendChild(a);\n      a.click();\n      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n      document.body.removeChild(a);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('下载文件失败:', error);\n      alert('下载文件失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handlePreview = (file: PublicKnowledgeFile) =&gt; {\n    const fileUrl = publicKnowledgeService.getFileUrl(file);\n    if (file.file_type.startsWith('image/')) {\n      setPreviewFile(file);\n    } else {\n      window.open(fileUrl, '_blank');\n    }\n  };\n\n  if (loading) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div\n;",

        "contents": "/**\n * 获取文件列表\n * GET /api/v1/ai-search/files?pageType=tech-package|press-release\n */\nrouter.get('/files', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    await initializeFileTable();\n\n    const category = req.query.category as string | undefined;\n    const conversationId = req.query.conversationId as string | undefined;\n    const pageType = req.query.pageType as string | undefined; // 'tech-package' | 'press-release'\n    const limit = req.query.limit ? parseInt(req.query.limit as string, 10) : undefined;\n    const offset = req.query.offset ? parseInt(req.query.offset as string, 10) : undefined;\n    const excludeGarbled = req.query.excludeGarbled !== 'false'; // 默认排除乱码文件名\n\n    const files = await fileService.getAllFiles({\n      category,\n      conversationId,\n      pageType,\n      limit,\n      offset,\n      excludeGarbled, // 默认排除乱码文件名\n    });\n\n    const fileList = files.map((file) =&gt; ({\n      id: file.file_id,\n      fileId: file.file_id,\n      name: file.original_name,\n      url: file.file_url,\n      type: file.mime_type,\n      size: file.file_size,\n      category: file.category,\n      tags: file.tags ? JSON.parse(file.tags) : [],\n      description: file.description,\n      usageCount: file.usage_count,\n      lastUsedAt: file.last_used_at,\n      createdAt: file.created_at,\n      updatedAt: file.updated_at,\n    }));\n\n    res.json(\n      formatApiResponse(true, fileList, '获取文件列表成功')\n    );\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(\n      formatApiResponse(\n        false,\n        null,\n        '获取文件列表失败',\n        error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n      )\n    );\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 删除文件（软删除）\n * DELETE /api/v1/ai-search/files/:fileId\n */",

      "codeBlock": {

            "line": 370,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export class FileService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有文件列表\n   */\n  async getAllFiles(options?: {\n    category?: string;\n    status?: string;\n    conversationId?: string;\n    pageType?: string; // 页面类型：'tech-package' | 'press-release'\n    limit?: number;\n    offset?: number;\n    excludeGarbled?: boolean; // 排除乱码文件名\n  }): Promise&lt;FileRecord[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      let sql = &#96;SELECT * FROM files WHERE 1=1&#96;;\n      const params: any[] = [];\n\n      if (options?.category) {\n        sql += &#96; AND category = ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.category);\n      }\n\n      if (options?.status) {\n        sql += &#96; AND status = ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.status);\n      } else {\n        sql += &#96; AND status = 'active'&#96;;\n      }\n\n      if (options?.conversationId) {\n        sql += &#96; AND conversation_id = ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.conversationId);\n      }\n\n      // 按页面类型过滤（通过metadata字段）\n      if (options?.pageType) {\n        // 只返回metadata中包含指定pageType的文件\n        sql += &#96; AND metadata LIKE ?&#96;;\n        params.push(&#96;%\"pageType\":\"${options.pageType}\"%&#96;);\n      }\n      // 如果没有指定pageType，返回所有文件（包括没有metadata的旧文件）\n\n      // 排除乱码文件名\n      if (options?.excludeGarbled) {\n        sql += &#96; AND original_name NOT LIKE '%ã€%' AND original_name NOT LIKE '%ç¥%' AND original_name NOT LIKE '%æ%'&#96;;\n      }\n\n      sql += &#96; ORDER BY created_at DESC&#96;;\n\n      if (options?.limit) {\n        sql += &#96; LIMIT ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.limit);\n      }\n\n      if (options?.offset) {\n        sql += &#96; OFFSET ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.offset);\n      }\n\n      const rows = await db.query(sql, params);\n      \n      // 基于文件哈希去重，只保留最新的记录\n      const fileMap = new Map&lt;string, FileRecord&gt;();\n      for (const row of rows as FileRecord[]) {\n        if (row.file_hash) {\n          const existing = fileMap.get(row.file_hash);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages = async \n\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响用户体验\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles();\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setPublicKnowledgeFiles(response.data);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载公共知识库文件失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 更新已配置的资源清单\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 区分文件来源和互联网信息点\n    // 文件来源：通过文件上传功能上传的文件（URL是文件路径，不是http链接）\n    // 互联网信息点：来自\"检索信息\"模块的来源（排除上传的文件，只包含http/https链接或没有URL的文本来源）\n    const files = sources.filter(s =&gt; {\n      // 文件上传的通常URL是文件路径，不是http链接\n      // 检查：type为external，且有url，且url不是http/https开头\n      // 文件URL特征：以/uploads/开头，或者包含文件扩展名（.pdf, .doc等）\n      \n      // 首先检查type\n      if (s.type !== 'external') {\n        return false;\n      }\n      \n      // 检查URL是否存在\n      const hasUrl = s.url &amp;&amp; (typeof s.url === 'string' || typeof s.url === 'object');\n      if (!hasUrl) {\n        console.log('[资源清单] ✗ 未识别为文件（无URL）:', { \n          id: s.id, \n          title: s.title, \n          type: s.type,\n          url: s.url,\n          urlType: typeof s.url\n        });\n        return false;\n      }\n      \n      // 处理URL（可能是字符串或对象）\n      let urlStr: string;\n      if (typeof s.url === 'string') {\n        urlStr = s.url.trim();\n      } else if (s.url &amp;&amp; typeof s.url === 'object' &amp;&amp; 'toString' in s.url) {\n        urlStr = String(s.url).trim();\n      } else {\n        console.log('[资源清单] ✗ 未识别为文件（URL格式异常）:', { \n          id: s.id, \n          title: s.title, \n          type: s.type,\n          url: s.url,\n          urlType: typeof s.url\n        });\n        return false;\n      }\n      \n      if (urlStr.length === 0) {\n        return false;\n      }\n    };\n  }\n;",

  "contents": "import { publicKnowledgeModel } from '../models';\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\nimport fs from 'fs';\nimport path from 'path';\nimport { CreateFileDTO, UpdateFileDTO, CreateCategoryDTO, UpdateCategoryDTO } from '../models/PublicKnowledge';\n\nexport class PublicKnowledgeService {\n  private uploadDir: string;\n\n  constructor() {\n    // 设置上传目录\n    this.uploadDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'backend', 'uploads', 'public-knowledge');\n    this.ensureUploadDir();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 确保上传目录存在\n   */\n  private ensureUploadDir(): void {\n    if (!fs.existsSync(this.uploadDir)) {\n      fs.mkdirSync(this.uploadDir, { recursive: true });\n      logger.info(&#96;创建上传目录: ${this.uploadDir}&#96;);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取上传目录路径\n   */\n  getUploadDir(): string {\n    return this.uploadDir;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 生成文件存储路径\n   */\n  generateFilePath(originalName: string): string {\n    const timestamp = Date.now();\n    const randomStr = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);\n    const ext = path.extname(originalName);\n    const baseName = path.basename(originalName, ext);\n    const sanitizedName = baseName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/g, '_');\n    const fileName = &#96;${timestamp}-${randomStr}-${sanitizedName}${ext}&#96;;\n    return path.join(this.uploadDir, fileName);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件的相对URL路径\n   */\n  getFileUrl(filePath: string): string {\n    const relativePath = path.relative(path.join(process.cwd(), 'backend'), filePath);\n    return &#96;/api/v1/public-knowledge/files/${path.basename(filePath)}&#96;;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 保存上传的文件\n   */\n  async saveUploadedFile(file: Express.Multer.File, categoryId?: number | null, description?: string, uploadedBy?: number): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try {\n      const filePath = this.generateFilePath(file.originalname);\n      \n      // 确保目录存在\n      const dir = path.dirname(filePath);\n      if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {\n        fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });\n      }\n\n      // 移动文件到目标位置\n      fs.writeFileSync(filePath, file.buffer);\n\n      // 创建文件记录\n      const fileData: CreateFileDTO = {\n        category_id: categoryId ?? null,\n        name: file.originalname,\n        file_path: filePath,\n        file_type: file.mimetype,\n        file_size: file.size,\n        description: description,\n        uploaded_by: uploadedBy\n      };\n\n      const fileRecord = await publicKnowledgeModel.createFile(fileData);\n      \n      logger.info('文件上传成功', {\n        fileId: fileRecord.id,\n        fileName: file.originalname,\n        filePath: filePath\n      });\n\n      return {\n        ...fileRecord,\n        file_url: this.getFileUrl(filePath)\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('保存上传文件失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除文件（包括物理文件）\n   */\n  async deleteFileWithPhysicalFile(fileId: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    try {\n      const file = await publicKnowledgeModel.getFileById(fileId);\n      if (!file) {\n        throw new Error('文件不存在');\n      }\n\n      // 删除物理文件\n      if (fs.existsSync(file.file_path)) {\n        fs.unlinkSync(file.file_path);\n        logger.info('物理文件已删除', { filePath: file.file_path });\n      }\n\n      // 删除数据库记录\n      await publicKnowledgeModel.deleteFile(fileId);\n      \n      logger.info('文件删除成功', { fileId });\n      return true;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('删除文件失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件流\n   */\n  async getFileStream(fileId: number): Promise&lt;{ stream: fs.ReadStream; file: any }&gt; {\n    const file = await publicKnowledgeModel.getFileById(fileId);\n    if (!file) {\n      throw new Error('文件不存在');\n    }\n\n    if (!fs.existsSync(file.file_path)) {\n      throw new Error('物理文件不存在');\n    }\n\n    const stream = fs.createReadStream(file.file_path);\n    return { stream, file };\n  }\n\n  // ==================== 分类相关方法 ====================\n\n  /**\n   * 创建分类\n   */\n  async createCategory(data: CreateCategoryDTO): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try {\n      return await publicKnowledgeModel.createCategory(data);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('创建分类失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取分类树\n   */\n  async getCategoryTree(): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try {\n      return await publicKnowledgeModel.getCategoryTree();\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取分类树失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有分类\n   */\n  async getAllCategories(): Promise&lt;any[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      return await publicKnowledgeModel.getAllCategories();\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取分类列表失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取分类详情\n   */\n  async getCategoryById(id: number): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try {\n      const category = await publicKnowledgeModel.getCategoryById(id);\n      if (!category) {\n        throw new Error('分类不存在');\n      }\n      return category;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取分类详情失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新分类\n   */\n  async updateCategory(id: number, data: UpdateCategoryDTO): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try {\n      const category = await publicKnowledgeModel.updateCategory(id, data);\n      if (!category) {\n        throw new Error('分类不存在');\n      }\n      return category;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('更新分类失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除分类（递归删除子分类和关联文件）\n   */\n  async deleteCategory(id: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt;   "contents": "import { Request, Response } from 'express';\nimport { publicKnowledgeService } from '../services/publicKnowledgeService';\nimport { logger } from '../shared/lib/logger';\nimport multer from 'multer';\n\n// 配置 multer 内存存储\nconst storage = multer.memoryStorage();\nconst upload = multer({\n  storage: storage,\n  limits: {\n    fileSize: 100 * 1024 * 1024 // 100MB\n  }\n});\n\nexport class PublicKnowledgeController {\n  /**\n   * 获取分类树\n   */\n  async getCategoryTree(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const tree = await publicKnowledgeService.getCategoryTree();\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: tree\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取分类树失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '获取分类树失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有分类\n   */\n  async getAllCategories(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const categories = await publicKnowledgeService.getAllCategories();\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: categories\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取分类列表失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '获取分类列表失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取分类详情\n   */\n  async getCategoryById(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的分类ID'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const category = await publicKnowledgeService.getCategoryById(id);\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: category\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取分类详情失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '获取分类详情失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 创建分类\n   */\n  async createCategory(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const { name, parent_id, sort_order } = req.body;\n\n      if (!name) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '分类名称不能为空'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const category = await publicKnowledgeService.createCategory({\n        name,\n        parent_id: parent_id !== undefined ? (parent_id === null ? null : parseInt(parent_id)) : undefined,\n        sort_order: sort_order !== undefined ? parseInt(sort_order) : undefined\n      });\n\n      res.status(201).json({\n        success: true,\n        data: category,\n        message: '分类创建成功'\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('创建分类失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '创建分类失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新分类\n   */\n  async updateCategory(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的分类ID'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const { name, parent_id, sort_order } = req.body;\n\n      const category = await publicKnowledgeService.updateCategory(id, {\n        name,\n        parent_id: parent_id !== undefined ? (parent_id === null ? null : parseInt(parent_id)) : undefined,\n        sort_order: sort_order !== undefined ? parseInt(sort_order) : undefined\n      });\n\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: category,\n        message: '分类更新成功'\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('更新分类失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '更新分类失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除分类\n   */\n  async deleteCategory(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的分类ID'\n        });\n      }\n\n      await publicKnowledgeService.deleteCategory(id);\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        message: '分类删除成功'\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('删除分类失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '删除分类失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件列表\n   */\n  async getFiles(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const { category_id } = req.query;\n      const categoryId = category_id === undefined \n        ? undefined \n        : category_id === 'null' || category_id === null \n          ? null \n          : parseInt(category_id as string);\n\n      const files = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles(categoryId);\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: files\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '获取文件列表失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件详情\n   */\n  async getFileById(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的文件ID'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const file = await publicKnowledgeService.getFileById(id);\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: file\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取文件详情失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '获取文件详情失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 上传文件\n   */\n  async uploadFile(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const uploadMiddleware = upload.single('file');\n      \n      uploadMiddleware(req, res, async (err) =&gt; {\n        if (err) {\n          logger.error('文件上传失败:', err);\n          return res.status(400).json({\n            success: false,\n            message: err.message || '文件上传失败'\n          });\n        }\n\n        if (!req.file) {\n          return res.status(400).json({\n            success: false,\n            message: '未选择文件'\n          });\n        }\n\n        try {\n          const { category_id, description, uploaded_by } = req.body;\n          const categoryId = category_id !== undefined \n            ? (category_id === 'null' || category_id === null ? null : parseInt(category_id))\n            : undefined;\n          const uploadedBy = uploaded_by ? parseInt(uploaded_by) : undefined;\n\n          const file = await publicKnowledgeService.saveUploadedFile(\n            req.file,\n            categoryId,\n            description,\n            uploadedBy\n          );\n\n          res.status(201).json({\n            success: true,\n            data: file,\n            message: '文件上传成功'\n          });\n        } catch (error) {\n          logger.error('保存文件失败:', error);\n          res.status(500).json({\n            success: false,\n            message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '保存文件失败'\n          });\n        }\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('上传文件失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '上传文件失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新文件\n   */\n  async updateFile(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的文件ID'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const { category_id, name, description } = req.body;\n\n      const file = await publicKnowledgeService.updateFile(id, {\n        category_id: category_id !== undefined \n          ? (category_id === 'null' || category_id === null ? null : parseInt(category_id))\n          : undefined,\n        name,\n        description\n      });\n\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        data: file,\n        message: '文件更新成功'\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('更新文件失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '更新文件失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除文件\n   */\n  async deleteFile(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的文件ID'\n        });\n      }\n\n      await publicKnowledgeService.deleteFile(id);\n      res.json({\n        success: true,\n        message: '文件删除成功'\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('删除文件失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '删除文件失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 下载文件\n   */\n  async downloadFile(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const id = parseInt(req.params.id);\n      if (isNaN(id)) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '无效的文件ID'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const { stream, file } = await publicKnowledgeService.getFileStream(id);\n\n      res.setHeader('Content-Type', file.file_type);\n      res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', &#96;attachment; filename=\"${encodeURIComponent(file.name)}\"&#96;);\n      res.setHeader('Content-Length', file.file_size);\n\n      stream.pipe(res);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('下载文件失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '下载文件失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件（用于直接访问）\n   * 注意：这个路由实际上由静态文件服务处理，但保留作为备用\n   */\n  async getFile(req: Request, res: Response) {\n    try {\n      const filename = req.params.filename;\n      const filePath = require('path').join(publicKnowledgeService.getUploadDir(), filename);\n\n      if (!require('fs').existsSync(filePath)) {\n        return res.status(404).json({\n          success: false,\n          message: '文件不存在'\n        });\n      }\n\n      const fileStream = require('fs').createReadStream(filePath);\n      fileStream.pipe(res);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取文件失败:', error);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        message: '获取文件失败'\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport const publicKnowledgeController = new PublicKnowledgeController();\n",

{\n    const response = await api.get&lt;CategoryTreeNode[]&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/categories/tree&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有分类\n   */\n  async getAllCategories(): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory[]&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.get&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory[]&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/categories&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取分类\n   */\n  async getCategoryById(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.get&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/categories/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 创建分类\n   */\n  async createCategory(data: CreateCategoryDTO): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.post&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/categories&#96;, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 更新分类\n   */\n  async updateCategory(id: number, data: UpdateCategoryDTO): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.put&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/categories/${id}&#96;, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 删除分类\n   */\n  async deleteCategory(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;void&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.delete&lt;void&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/categories/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  // ==================== 文件相关 ====================\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件列表\n   */\n  async getFiles(categoryId?: number | null): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile[]&gt;&gt; {\n    const params: any = {};\n    if (categoryId !== undefined) {\n      params.category_id = categoryId === null ? 'null' : categoryId;\n    }\n    const response = await api.get&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile[]&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/files&#96;, { params });\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取文件\n   */\n  async getFileById(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.get&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/files/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 上传文件\n   */\n  async uploadFile(\n    file: File,\n    data?: CreateFileDTO\n  ): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile&gt;&gt; {\n    const formData = new FormData();\n    formData.append('file', file);\n    \n    if (data?.category_id !== undefined) {\n      formData.append('category_id', data.category_id === null ? 'null' : String(data.category_id));\n    }\n    if (data?.description) {\n      formData.append('description', data.description);\n    }\n    if (data?.uploaded_by) {\n      formData.append('uploaded_by', String(data.uploaded_by));\n    }\n\n    // 使用 axios 直接上传，因为 api 封装可能不支持 FormData\n    const axios = (await import('axios')).default;\n    const baseURL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api/v1';\n    const response = await axios.post&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile&gt;&gt;(\n      &#96;${baseURL}${BASE_URL}/upload&#96;,\n      formData,\n      {\n        headers: {\n          'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data',\n        },\n      }\n    );\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 更新文件\n   */\n  async updateFile(id: number, data: UpdateFileDTO): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.put&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/files/${id}&#96;, data);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 删除文件\n   */\n  async deleteFile(id: number): Promise&lt;ApiResponse&lt;void&gt;&gt; {\n    const response = await api.delete&lt;void&gt;(&#96;${BASE_URL}/files/${id}&#96;);\n    return response.data;\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 下载文件\n   */\n  async downloadFile(id: number): Promise&lt;Blob&gt; {\n    const response = await fetch(&#96;${import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api/v1'}${BASE_URL}/files/${id}/download&#96;);\n    if (!response.ok) {\n      throw new Error('下载文件失败');\n    }\n    return response.blob();\n  },\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件URL\n   */\n  getFileUrl(file: PublicKnowledgeFile): string {\n    if (file.file_url) {\n      return file.file_url;\n    }\n    // 如果没有file_url，使用file_path构建URL\n    const fileName = file.file_path.split('/').pop() || '';\n    return &#96;${import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE_URL || '/api/v1'}${BASE_URL}/files/${fileName}&#96;;\n  }\n};\n",

[] : [parentId];\n    \n    const result = await this.db.query(sql, values);\n    return result as PublicKnowledgeCategory[];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取分类树\n   */\n  async getCategoryTree(): Promise&lt;CategoryTreeNode[]&gt; {\n    const allCategories = await this.getAllCategories();\n    \n    // 构建分类映射\n    const categoryMap = new Map&lt;number, CategoryTreeNode&gt;();\n    const rootCategories: CategoryTreeNode[] = [];\n\n    // 初始化所有分类\n    allCategories.forEach(category =&gt; {\n      categoryMap.set(category.id, { ...category, children: [] });\n    });\n\n    // 构建父子关系\n    allCategories.forEach(category =&gt; {\n      const categoryNode = categoryMap.get(category.id)!;\n      \n      if (category.parent_id === null) {\n        rootCategories.push(categoryNode);\n      } else {\n        const parent = categoryMap.get(category.parent_id);\n        if (parent) {\n          if (!parent.children) {\n            parent.children = [];\n          }\n          parent.children.push(categoryNode);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n\n    return rootCategories;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 更新分类\n   */\n  async updateCategory(id: number, data: UpdateCategoryDTO): Promise&lt;PublicKnowledgeCategory | null&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    const fields: string[] = [];\n    const values: any[] = [];\n    let paramIndex = 1;\n\n    if (data.name !== undefined) {\n      const dbType = this.db.getType();\n      fields.push(dbType === 'sqlite' ?         "contents": "// 配置multer用于文件上传\nconst storage = multer.diskStorage({\n  destination: (req, file, cb) =&gt; {\n    cb(null, 'uploads/ai-search/');\n  },\n  filename: (req, file, cb) =&gt; {\n    // 生成唯一文件名，但保留原始扩展名\n    const uniqueSuffix = Date.now() + '-' + Math.round(Math.random() * 1E9);\n    const ext = path.extname(file.originalname);\n    cb(null, &#96;${uniqueSuffix}${ext}&#96;);\n  },\n});\n\nconst upload = multer({\n  storage: storage,\n  limits: {\n    fileSize: 10 * 1024 * 1024, // 10MB\n  },\n  fileFilter: (req: Request, file: Express.Multer.File, cb: multer.FileFilterCallback) =&gt;         "contents": "import express from 'express';\nimport multer from 'multer';\nimport path from 'path';\nimport fs from 'fs';\nimport DifyClient from '../services/DifyClient';\nimport { formatApiResponse, formatValidationErrorResponse } from '../utils/validation';\nimport { aiRoleModel } from '../models';\nimport { CreateAIRoleDTO, UpdateAIRoleDTO } from '../models/AIRole';\nimport { OpenAIProvider } from '../services/llm/OpenAIProvider';\nimport { ChatMessage } from '../services/llm/types';\nimport { AgentOrchestrator } from '../services/agent/AgentOrchestrator';\nimport { FileService } from '../services/FileService';\n\nconst router = express.Router();\n\n// 配置multer用于文件上传\nconst storage = multer.diskStorage({\n  destination: (req, file, cb) =&gt;         "contents": "export class PublicKnowledgeService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 保存上传的文件\n   */\n  async saveUploadedFile(file: Express.Multer.File, categoryId?: number | null, description?: string, uploadedBy?: number): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try {\n      const filePath = this.generateFilePath(file.originalname);\n      \n      // 确保目录存在\n      const dir = path.dirname(filePath);\n      if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {\n        fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });\n      }\n\n      // 移动文件到目标位置\n      fs.writeFileSync(filePath, file.buffer);\n\n      // 创建文件记录\n      const fileData: CreateFileDTO = {\n        category_id: categoryId ?? null,\n        name: file.originalname,\n        file_path: filePath,\n        file_type: file.mimetype,\n        file_size: file.size,\n        description: description,\n        uploaded_by: uploadedBy\n      };\n\n      const fileRecord = await publicKnowledgeModel.createFile(fileData);\n      \n      logger.info('文件上传成功', {\n        fileId: fileRecord.id,\n        fileName: file.originalname,\n        filePath: filePath\n      });\n\n      return {\n        ...fileRecord,\n        file_url: this.getFileUrl(filePath)\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('保存上传文件失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除文件（包括物理文件）\n   */\n  async deleteFileWithPhysicalFile(fileId: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    try\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class PublicKnowledgeService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 生成文件存储路径\n   */\n  generateFilePath(originalName: string): string {\n    const timestamp = Date.now();\n    const randomStr = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);\n    const ext = path.extname(originalName);\n    const baseName = path.basename(originalName, ext);\n    const sanitizedName = baseName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/g, '_');\n    const fileName = &#96;${timestamp}-${randomStr}-${sanitizedName}${ext}&#96;;\n    return path.join(this.uploadDir, fileName);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件的相对URL路径\n   */\n  getFileUrl(filePath: string): string {\n    const relativePath = path.relative(path.join(process.cwd(), 'backend'), filePath);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "// 生产环境静态文件服务：直接从 frontend/dist 提供资源\n// 注意：必须在 API 路由之后，否则会拦截 API 请求\n// 仅在非开发环境或明确需要时才启用静态文件服务\nconst isDev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production';\nif (!isDev) {\n  const distDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../frontend/dist');\n  app.use(express.static(distDir, {\n    maxAge: 0,\n    etag: true,\n    lastModified: true,\n  }));\n\n  // SPA Fallback：除 /api/* 外的所有路由都返回 index.html\n  app.get(/^(\\/(?!api).*)$/, (_req, res) =&gt; {\n    res.sendFile(path.join(distDir, 'index.html'));\n  });\n}\n\n// 全局错误处理中间件\n// 注意：这个中间件必须放在所有路由之后，且必须有4个参数 (err, req, res, next)\napp.use((err: any, req: any, res: any, next: any) =&gt; {\n  // 如果响应已经发送，则委托给默认的 Express 错误处理\n  if (res.headersSent) {\n    return next(err);\n  }\n\n  // 记录错误详情\n  logger.error('全局错误处理', {\n    error: err,\n    stack: err?.stack,\n    requestUrl: req.url,\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\n    method: req.method,\n    path: req.path,\n    body: req.body,\n    params: req.params,\n    query: req.query,\n  });\n\n  // 发送到错误追踪\n  errorTracking.captureException(\n    err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)),\n    {\n      context: {\n        metadata: {\n          method: req.method,\n          path: req.path,\n          body: req.body,\n          params: req.params,\n          query: req.query,\n        },\n      },\n    }\n  );\n\n  // 根据错误类型返回不同的状态码\n  const statusCode = err.statusCode || err.status || 500;\n  const errorMessage =\n    process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'\n      ? '服务器内部错误'\n      : err.message || 'Unknown error';\n\n  res.status(statusCode).json({\n    success: false,\n    message: 'Internal server error',\n    error: errorMessage,\n    ...(process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' &amp;&amp; { stack: err?.stack }),\n  });\n});\n\n// 启动服务器前测试数据库连接\nasync function startServer() {\n  try\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 文件上传\n * POST /api/v1/ai-search/upload\n */\nrouter.post(\n  '/upload',\n  upload.array('files', 10),\n  async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 确保文件表已初始化\n      await initializeFileTable();\n\n      const files = req.files as Express.Multer.File[];\n      \n      if (!files || files.length === 0) {\n        return res.status(400).json(\n          formatApiResponse(false, null, '没有上传文件')\n        );\n      }\n\n      const conversationId = req.body.conversationId || req.query.conversationId;\n      const uploaderId = req.body.uploaderId || req.query.uploaderId;\n      const pageType = req.body.pageType || req.query.pageType as string | undefined; // 'tech-package' | 'press-release'\n\n      // 保存文件到数据库\n      const uploadedFiles = await Promise.all(\n        files.map(async (file) =&gt; {\n          const filePath = file.path;\n        }\n;\n  }",

        "contents": "{\n  \"name\": \"todify3\",\n  \"version\": \"1.0.0\",\n  \"main\": \"index.js\",\n  \"scripts\": {\n    \"test\": \"vitest\",\n    \"test:run\": \"vitest --run\",\n    \"test:coverage\": \"vitest --coverage --run\",\n    \"test:watch\": \"vitest --watch\",\n    \"test:bocha\": \"ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register scripts/test-bocha-api.ts\",\n    \"dev\": \"ts-node-dev --respawn --transpile-only -r tsconfig-paths/register src/index.ts\",\n    \"start\": \"node dist/index.js\",\n    \"build\": \"tsc &amp;&amp; tsc-alias\",\n    \"prod\": \"npm run build &amp;&amp; npm start\"\n  },\n  \"keywords\": [],\n  \"author\": \"\",\n  \"license\": \"ISC\",\n  \"description\": \"\",\n  \"dependencies\": {\n    \"@sentry/node\": \"^10.23.0\",\n    \"@tailwindcss/typography\": \"^0.5.19\",\n    \"@types/cors\": \"^2.8.19\",\n    \"@types/multer\": \"^2.0.0\",\n    \"@types/pg\": \"^8.15.5\",\n    \"@types/uuid\": \"^10.0.0\",\n    \"axios\": \"^1.12.2\",\n    \"cors\": \"^2.8.5\",\n    \"dotenv\": \"^17.2.3\",\n    \"express\": \"^5.1.0\",\n    \"mammoth\": \"^1.11.0\",\n    \"multer\": \"^2.0.2\",\n    \"pdf-parse\": \"^2.4.5\",\n    \"pg\": \"^8.16.3\",\n    \"pino\": \"^8.21.0\",\n    \"pino-pretty\": \"^10.3.1\",\n    \"prom-client\": \"^15.1.3\",\n    \"sonner\": \"^2.0.7\",\n    \"sqlite3\": \"^5.1.7\",\n    \"uuid\": \"^9.0.1\",\n    \"zod\": \"^3.23.8\"\n  },\n  \"devDependencies\": {\n    \"@types/express\": \"^5.0.3\",\n    \"@types/node\": \"^24.7.2\",\n    \"ts-node\": \"^10.9.2\",\n    \"ts-node-dev\": \"^2.0.0\",\n    \"tsc-alias\": \"^1.8.16\",\n    \"tsconfig-paths\": \"^4.2.0\",\n    \"typescript\": \"^5.9.3\",\n    \"vite-tsconfig-paths\": \"^5.1.4\",\n    \"vitest\": \"^4.0.7\"\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 发送消息\n * POST /api/v1/ai-search/conversations/:id/messages\n */\nrouter.post(\n  '/conversations/:id/messages',\n  ensureTablesInitialized,\n  upload.array('files', 10),\n  async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const { id } = req.params;\n      let sourcesValue = req.body.sources;\n      if (typeof sourcesValue === 'string') {\n        try {\n          sourcesValue = JSON.parse(sourcesValue);\n        } catch (parseError) {\n          logger.warn('解析sources失败，使用原始值', { parseError });\n          sourcesValue = undefined;\n        }\n      }\n\n      const body = {\n        content: req.body.content,\n        sources: Array.isArray(sourcesValue) ? sourcesValue : undefined,\n        contextWindowSize: req.body.contextWindowSize,\n        workflowId: req.body.workflowId,\n        fileList: req.body.fileList,\n        knowledgeBaseNames: req.body.knowledgeBaseNames,\n      };\n      const files = req.files as Express.Multer.File[];\n\n      const dto = validateDTO(SendMessageSchema, body);\n      const result = await sendMessageUseCase.execute({\n        conversationId: id,\n        content: dto.content,\n        sources: dto.sources,\n        files,\n        contextWindowSize: typeof dto.contextWindowSize === 'number' ? dto.contextWindowSize : (dto.contextWindowSize ? parseInt(String(dto.contextWindowSize), 10) : undefined),\n        workflowId: dto.workflowId,\n        fileList: dto.fileList,\n        knowledgeBaseNames: dto.knowledgeBaseNames,\n      });\n\n      if (!result.success) {\n        return res.status(500).json(\n          formatApiResponse(false, null, '发送消息失败', result.error.message)\n        );\n      }\n\n      res.json(\n        formatApiResponse(\n          true,\n          result.value,\n          result.value.error ? '发送消息成功，但工作流执行失败' : '发送消息成功'\n        )\n      );\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (error instanceof ValidationException) {\n        const failure = formatValidationFailure(error);\n  }",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./guide/workflow/DIFY_FILE_UPLOAD_ANALYSIS.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 78
          }
        },
        "contents": "# Dify 文件上传与传递分析\n\n根据 Dify 对话 API 文档，分析文件传递的正确方式。\n\n## 📋 API 文档关键信息\n\n### 1. 文件上传接口 (POST /files/upload)\n\n**请求格式：**\n- Content-Type: &#96;multipart/form-data&#96;\n- 参数：\n  - &#96;file&#96;: 要上传的文件\n  - &#96;user&#96;: 用户标识（必须和发送消息接口的 user 一致）\n\n**响应格式：**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"id\": \"72fa9618-8f89-4a37-9b33-7e1178a24a67\",\n  \"name\": \"example.png\",\n  \"size\": 1024,\n  \"extension\": \"png\",\n  \"mime_type\": \"image/png\",\n  \"created_by\": 123,\n  \"created_at\": 1577836800\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. 发送消息接口 (POST /chat-messages)\n\n**文件字段格式：**\n\n&#96;files&#96; 字段应该是**对象数组**，每个对象包含：\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n{\n  type: string;              // 文件类型：document | image | audio | video | custom\n  transfer_method: string;   // 传递方式：local_file | remote_url\n  upload_file_id?: string;   // 文件 ID（仅当 transfer_method 为 local_file 时）\n  url?: string;              // 文件 URL（仅当 transfer_method 为 remote_url 时）\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**文件类型支持：**\n- &#96;document&#96;: TXT, MD, MARKDOWN, PDF, HTML, XLSX, XLS, DOCX, CSV, EML, MSG, PPTX, PPT, XML, EPUB\n- &#96;image&#96;: JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, SVG\n- &#96;audio&#96;: MP3, M4A, WAV, WEBM, AMR\n- &#96;video&#96;: MP4, MOV, MPEG, MPGA\n- &#96;custom&#96;: 其他文件类型\n\n**示例请求：**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"query\": \"What are the specs of the iPhone 13 Pro Max?\",\n  \"inputs\": {},\n  \"response_mode\": \"blocking\",\n  \"conversation_id\": \"\",\n  \"user\": \"abc-123\",\n  \"files\": [\n    {\n      \"type\": \"image\",\n      \"transfer_method\": \"remote_url\",\n      \"url\": \"https://cloud.dify.ai/logo/logo-site.png\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"type\": \"document\",\n      \"transfer_method\": \"local_file\",\n      \"upload_file_id\": \"72fa9618-8f89-4a37-9b33-7e1178a24a67\"\n    }\n  ]\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 🔧 当前实现分析\n\n### ✅ 正确的部分\n\n1. **文件上传流程正确**：\n   - 通过 &#96;/files/upload&#96; 接口上传文件",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Dify 文件上传与传递分析",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2

          {
            "text": "根据 Dify 对话 API 文档，分析文件传递的正确方式。",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📋 API 文档关键信息",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "### 1. 文件上传接口 (POST /files/upload)",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "**请求格式：**",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "- Content-Type: &#96;multipart/form-data&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- 参数：",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;file&#96;: 要上传的文件",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "  - &#96;user&#96;: 用户标识（必须和发送消息接口的 user 一致）",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "**响应格式：**",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;json",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "{",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "  \"id\": \"72fa9618-8f89-4a37-9b33-7e1178a24a67\",",

          },

            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "  \"created_at\": 1577836800",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "### 2. 发送消息接口 (POST /chat-messages)",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "**文件字段格式：**",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;files&#96; 字段应该是**对象数组**，每个对象包含：",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "{",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "  type: string;              // 文件类型：document | image | audio | video | custom",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "  transfer_method: string;   // 传递方式：local_file | remote_url",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "**文件类型支持：**",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;document&#96;: TXT, MD, MARKDOWN, PDF, HTML, XLSX, XLS, DOCX, CSV, EML, MSG, PPTX, PPT, XML, EPUB",

          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;image&#96;: JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, WEBP, SVG",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {

          },

        "contents": "export class WorkflowEngine {\nprivate async executeInputNode(node: AgentWorkflowNode, workflowInput: any): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n\n      \n      // 如果是文件类型，处理文件\n      if (inputParam.type === 'file' &amp;&amp; value) {\n        // 如果是File对象，转换为base64或保存文件信息\n        if (value instanceof File) {\n          // 检查文件大小限制\n          if (inputParam.maxSize &amp;&amp; value.size &gt; inputParam.maxSize) {\n            throw new Error(&#96;文件 ${inputName} 大小超过限制 ${(inputParam.maxSize / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)}MB&#96;);\n          }\n          \n          // 检查文件类型\n          if (inputParam.accept) {\n            const accepts = inputParam.accept.split(',').map(a =&gt; a.trim());\n            const fileType = value.type || '';\n            const fileName = value.name || '';\n            const fileExt = fileName.includes('.') ? '.' + fileName.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase() : '';\n            \n            const isValidType = accepts.some(accept =&gt; {\n              if (accept.startsWith('.')) {\n                return fileExt === accept || fileExt === accept.toLowerCase();\n              } else if (accept.includes('*')) {\n                const baseType = accept.split('/')[0];\n                return fileType.startsWith(baseType + '/');\n              } else {\n                return fileType === accept || fileExt === accept;\n              }\n            });\n            \n            if (!isValidType) {\n              throw new Error(&#96;文件 ${inputName} 类型不符合要求，需要: ${inputParam.accept}&#96;);\n            }\n          }\n          \n          // 将文件转换为base64（对于小文件）或保存文件信息\n          // 这里可以根据实际需求选择处理方式\n          value = {\n            name: value.name,\n            type: value.type,\n            size: value.size,\n            lastModified: value.lastModified,\n            // 如果需要，可以在这里读取文件内容为base64\n            // content: await this.fileToBase64(value),\n          };\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 将输入值保存到共享上下文\n      this.execution!.sharedContext[inputName] = value;\n      \n      results.push({\n        name: inputName,\n        value,\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nprivate async buildConversationData(\n    params: {\n      conversation: any | null;\n      content: string;\n      sources?: any[];\n      files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n      contextWindowSize?: number;\n      workflowId?: string;\n      fileList?: string;\n      knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n    }\n  ) {\n\n,\n      });\n    }\n\n    return {\n      query: finalQuery,\n      summary: context.summary,\n      keyPhrases: context.keyPhrases,\n      sources: effectiveSources,\n      files:\n        params.files?.map((f) =&gt; ({\n          name: f.originalname,\n          url: &#96;/uploads/ai-search/${f.filename}&#96;,\n          type: f.mimetype,\n        })) || [],\n      fileList: fileListArray, // 文件列表数组\n      knowledgeBaseNames: knowledgeBaseNamesArray, // 知识库名称数组\n      // 注意：使用 Dify 的 conversation_id，不是本地对话ID\n      // 首次对话时为空，Dify 会返回新的 conversation_id\n      conversationId: params.conversation?.difyConversationId || '',\n      history: context.history,\n      historySize: context.historySize,\n      historyLimit: context.historyLimit,\n      metadata: {\n        contextGeneratedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        workflowId: params.workflowId,\n      },\n    };\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import fs from 'fs';\nimport path from 'path';\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\n\n/**\n * 文件转Markdown服务\n * 将PDF、Word、PPT、TXT、Markdown等文件转换为Markdown格式\n */\nexport class FileToMarkdownService {\n  /**\n   * 将文件转换为Markdown格式\n   * @param filePath 文件路径\n   * @param mimeType 文件MIME类型\n   * @param originalName 原始文件名\n   * @returns Markdown格式的文本内容\n   */\n  async convertToMarkdown(\n    filePath: string,\n    mimeType: string,\n    originalName: string\n  ): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n    try {\n      const fileExtension = path.extname(originalName).toLowerCase();\n      \n      // 根据文件类型选择转换方法\n      if (mimeType === 'application/pdf' || fileExtension === '.pdf') {\n        return await this.convertPdfToMarkdown(filePath, originalName);\n      } else if (\n        mimeType === 'application/msword' ||\n        mimeType === 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document' ||\n        fileExtension === '.doc' ||\n        fileExtension === '.docx'\n      ) {\n        return await this.convertWordToMarkdown(filePath, originalName);\n      } else if (\n        mimeType === 'application/vnd.ms-powerpoint' ||\n        mimeType === 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation' ||\n        fileExtension === '.ppt' ||\n        fileExtension === '.pptx'\n      ) {\n        return await this.convertPptToMarkdown(filePath, originalName);\n      } else if (\n        mimeType === 'text/plain' ||\n        mimeType === 'text/markdown' ||\n        fileExtension === '.txt' ||\n        fileExtension === '.md' ||\n        fileExtension === '.markdown'\n      ) {\n        return await this.convertTextToMarkdown(filePath, originalName);\n      } else {\n        logger.warn('不支持的文件类型，返回空内容', { mimeType, fileExtension, originalName });\n        return &#96;# ${originalName}\\n\\n不支持的文件类型: ${mimeType}&#96;;\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('文件转Markdown失败', {\n        filePath,\n        mimeType,\n        originalName,\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n      });\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 转换PDF为Markdown\n   */\n  private async convertPdfToMarkdown(filePath: string, originalName: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./guide/workflow/DIFY_FIELD_MAPPING.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 86
          }
        },
        "contents": "# Dify工作流字段对接文档\n\n## 📋 概述\n\n本文档基于 &#96;robot1-技术包装.yml&#96; 工作流配置，详细说明了Todify系统与Dify工作流的字段对接要求。\n\n## 🔍 工作流结构分析\n\n### 工作流节点流程\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n开始 → 上游信息解读(LLM) → 信息整合输出(LLM) → 结束\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 技术配置\n- **模型**: GPT-4\n- **温度**: 0.7\n- **模式**: 聊天模式\n- **文件上传**: 支持但当前未启用\n\n## 📥 输入字段映射\n\n### 字段映射表\n\n| Dify字段 | 系统字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 限制 | 说明 |\n|---------|---------|------|------|------|------|\n| &#96;input1&#96; | &#96;upstream_info&#96; | paragraph | ✅ 是 | 5000字符 | 上游信息 |\n| &#96;input2&#96; | &#96;files&#96; | file-list | ❌ 否 | 5个文件 | 附件上传 |\n| &#96;input3&#96; | &#96;optimization_suggestions&#96; | paragraph | ❌ 否 | 1000字符 | 优化建议 |\n\n### 详细字段说明\n\n#### 1. input1 - 上游信息\n&#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\n# Dify配置\n- default: ''\n  hint: ''\n  label: 上游信息\n  max_length: 5000\n  options: []\n  placeholder: ''\n  required: true\n  type: paragraph\n  variable: input1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**系统实现要求:**\n- **字段名**: &#96;input1&#96; 或 &#96;upstream_info&#96;\n- **类型**: 字符串 (paragraph)\n- **必填**: 是\n- **最大长度**: 5000字符\n- **UI组件**: 多行文本输入框\n- **验证规则**: 非空 + 长度限制\n\n#### 2. input2 - 附件上传\n&#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\n# Dify配置\n- allowed_file_extensions: []\n  allowed_file_types:\n  - image\n  - document\n  allowed_file_upload_methods:\n  - local_file\n  - remote_url\n  default: ''\n  hint: ''\n  label: 附件上传\n  max_length: 5\n  options: []\n  placeholder: ''\n  required: false\n  type: file-list\n  variable: input2\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**系统实现要求:**\n- **字段名**: &#96;input2&#96; 或 &#96;files&#96;\n- **类型**: 文件数组 (file-list)\n- **必填**: 否\n- **最大文件数**: 5个\n- **支持类型**: 图片、文档\n- **支持扩展名**: .JPG, .JPEG, .PNG, .GIF, .WEBP, .SVG\n- **上传方式**: 本地文件、远程URL\n- **UI组件**: 文件上传组件\n\n#### 3. input3 - 优化建议\n&#96;&#96;&#96;yaml",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "contents": "-- 文件存储表\n-- 用于存储上传的文件信息，支持后续反复调用\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (\n  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n  file_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- 文件唯一标识\n  original_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- 原始文件名\n  stored_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- 存储的文件名\n  file_path TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件存储路径\n  file_url TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件访问URL\n  mime_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 文件MIME类型\n  file_size INTEGER NOT NULL, -- 文件大小（字节）\n  file_hash TEXT, -- 文件哈希值（用于去重）\n  category TEXT DEFAULT 'general', -- 文件分类（general, document, image等）\n  tags TEXT, -- JSON数组格式存储标签\n  description TEXT, -- 文件描述\n  uploader_id TEXT, -- 上传者ID\n  conversation_id TEXT, -- 关联的对话ID（可选）\n  usage_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 使用次数\n  last_used_at DATETIME, -- 最后使用时间\n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'deleted')),\n  metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储额外信息\n  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引以提高查询性能\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_file_id ON files(file_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_category ON files(category);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_status ON files(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_conversation_id ON files(conversation_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_created_at ON files(created_at);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_file_hash ON files(file_hash);",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nprivate async buildConversationData(\n    params: {\n      conversation: any | null;\n      content: string;\n      sources?: any[];\n      files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n      contextWindowSize?: number;\n      workflowId?: string;\n      fileList?: string;\n      knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n    }\n  ) {\n\n    if (params.files &amp;&amp; params.files.length &gt; 0) {\n      try {\n        // 通过文件名查找文件记录，获取markdown内容\n        for (const file of params.files) {\n          try {\n            // 通过原始文件名查找文件记录\n            const allFiles = await fileService.getAllFiles({\n              status: 'active',\n            });\n            const fileRecord = allFiles.find(\n              (f) =&gt; f.original_name === file.originalname || f.stored_name === file.filename\n            );\n            \n            if (fileRecord &amp;&amp; fileRecord.metadata) {\n              const metadata = typeof fileRecord.metadata === 'string' \n                ? JSON.parse(fileRecord.metadata) \n                : fileRecord.metadata;\n              \n              if (metadata.markdownContent) {\n                fileMarkdownContents.push(&#96;【${fileRecord.original_name}】\\n${metadata.markdownContent}&#96;);\n                logger.info('从文件记录中提取markdown内容', {\n                  fileName: fileRecord.original_name,\n                  markdownLength: metadata.markdownContent.length,\n                });\n              }\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            logger.warn('提取文件markdown内容失败', {\n              fileName: file.originalname,\n              error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n            });\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        logger.warn('批量提取文件markdown内容失败', {\n          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 判断是否是第一次对话（对话不存在或没有历史消息）\n    const isFirstMessage = !params.conversation || \n                          !params.conversation.messages || \n                          params.conversation.messages.length === 0;\n    \n    // 提取附加信息：外部来源的文本内容和文件的markdown内容\n    let additionalContext = '';\n    \n    const textContents: string[] = [];\n  }\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./backend/src/index.ts",
        "range": {

            "line": 65,
            "column": 30
          }
        },
        "contents": "// 性能监控中间件（放在最前面）\nif (performanceMonitor &amp;&amp; typeof performanceMonitor.middleware === 'function') {\n  app.use(performanceMonitor.middleware());\n} else {\n  logger.warn('性能监控中间件未正确加载，跳过');\n}\n\n// Prometheus 指标中间件（放在性能监控之后）\nif (prometheusMetrics &amp;&amp; typeof prometheusMetrics.middleware === 'function') {\n  app.use(prometheusMetrics.middleware());\n} else {\n  logger.warn('Prometheus 指标中间件未正确加载，跳过');\n}\n\n// 添加请求日志中间件（放在最前面，但要在路由之前）\napp.use((req, res, next) =&gt; {\n  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();\n  logger.info('收到请求', {\n    timestamp,\n    method: req.method,\n    url: req.url,\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\n    ip: req.ip || req.connection.remoteAddress,\n    userAgent: req.get('User-Agent'),\n    body: req.body,\n    authorization: req.get('Authorization')?.substring(0, 20),\n    contentType: req.get('Content-Type'),\n  });\n  next();\n});\n\n// API 路由必须放在静态文件服务之前\n// 路由配置（API 保持 /api/v1 前缀）\napp.use('/api/v1', apiRoutes);",

已修复文件名编码问题。修复内容如下：

## 修复内容

1. **添加了文件名编码修复方法** (`fixFileNameEncoding`)：
   - 检测乱码字符（UTF-8 被误读为 Latin-1 的典型特征）
   - 将 Latin-1 编码的字符串转换为 UTF-8
   - 验证解码后的字符串是否包含中文字符

2. **在所有相关方法中应用编码修复**：
   - `saveUploadedFile`：保存文件时修复文件名编码
   - `getFiles`：获取文件列表时修复编码（处理已存在的乱码数据）
   - `getFileById`：获取文件详情时修复编码
   - `updateFile`：更新文件时修复编码
   - `getFileStream`：下载文件时修复编码

## 修复原理

当浏览器上传包含中文的文件名时，如果 multer 将 UTF-8 编码的文件名误读为 Latin-1（ISO-8859-1），会导致乱码。修复方法：
- 检测乱码特征（如 `ã€`、`ç¥`、`æ` 等）
- 将字符串按 Latin-1 读取为 Buffer，再转换为 UTF-8
- 验证是否包含中文字符，确认修复成功

现在：
- 新上传的文件名会正确保存和显示
- 已存在的乱码文件名在显示时会被自动修复

请重新上传一个包含中文文件名的 PDF 文件进行测试，文件名应能正确显示。

已实现多文件上传功能。修改摘要：

## 修改内容

### 1. **后端接口** (`PublicKnowledgeController.ts`)
- 将 `upload.single('file')` 改为 `upload.array('files', 50)`，支持最多 50 个文件
- 使用 `Promise.all` 批量上传文件
- 返回格式：单个文件返回对象，多个文件返回数组

### 2. **前端 UploadModal 组件**
- 将 `file` 状态改为 `files` 数组
- 文件输入框添加 `multiple` 属性
- 支持拖拽多个文件
- 显示已选择文件列表，每个文件可单独移除
- 支持继续添加文件
- 显示已选择文件数量
- 上传按钮显示文件数量

### 3. **前端服务** (`publicKnowledgeService.ts`)
- `uploadFile` 方法支持接收单个文件或文件数组
- 使用 `files` 作为 FormData 字段名（与后端一致）
- 返回类型支持单个文件或文件数组

### 4. **页面处理逻辑** (`PublicKnowledgePage`)
- `handleUploadFile` 接收文件数组
- 根据返回结果显示成功消息

## 功能特性

- 支持同时选择多个文件（点击选择或拖拽）
- 显示已选择文件列表，每个文件显示名称和大小
- 可单独移除某个文件
- 可继续添加更多文件
- 批量上传所有文件
- 上传进度提示（显示文件数量）
- 最多支持 50 个文件同时上传

现在可以：
1. 点击“上传文件”按钮
2. 在弹窗中同时选择多个文件（拖拽或点击选择）
3. 查看已选择的文件列表
4. 移除不需要的文件
5. 继续添加更多文件
6. 点击“上传”按钮批量上传所有文件

所有文件将上传到当前选中的分类（如果有），并共享同一个描述（如果填写了）。

        "contents": "export class PublicKnowledgeService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 更新文件\n   */\n  async updateFile(id: number, data: UpdateFileDTO): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    try {\n      const file = await publicKnowledgeModel.updateFile(id, data);\n      if (!file) {\n        throw new Error('文件不存在');\n      }\n      return {\n        ...file,\n        name: this.fixFileNameEncoding(file.name), // 修复文件名编码\n        file_url: this.getFileUrl(file.file_path)\n      };\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('更新文件失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 删除文件\n   */\n  async deleteFile(id: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n    return this.deleteFileWithPhysicalFile(id);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "if [ $backend_port_free -ne 0 ]; then\n    if ! cleanup_port $BACKEND_PORT \"后端服务\"; then\n        echo \"❌ 无法清理端口 $BACKEND_PORT，请手动处理后重试\"\n        exit 1\n    fi\nfi\n\ncheck_port $FRONTEND_PORT\nfrontend_port_free=$?\nif [ $frontend_port_free -ne 0 ]; then\n    if ! cleanup_port $FRONTEND_PORT \"前端服务\"; then\n        echo \"⚠️  前端端口 $FRONTEND_PORT 被占用，但将继续启动（前端可能稍后启动）\"\n    fi\nfi\n\n# 安装依赖函数\ninstall_dependencies() {\n    local dir=$1\n    local name=$2\n    \n    echo \"📦 检查 $name 依赖...\"\n    cd \"$dir\"\n    \n    if [ ! -d \"node_modules\" ]; then\n        echo \"📥 安装 $name 依赖...\"\n        npm install\n        if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then\n            echo \"❌ $name 依赖安装失败\"\n            exit 1\n        fi\n    else\n        echo \"✅ $name 依赖已存在\"\n    fi\n}\n\n# 修复后端依赖（ARM64架构兼容性）\nfix_backend_dependencies() {\n    local dir=$1\n    echo \"🔧 检查后端依赖兼容性...\"\n    cd \"$dir\"\n    \n    # 检查架构\n    ARCH=$(uname -m)\n    if [ \"$ARCH\" = \"arm64\" ] || [ \"$ARCH\" = \"arm64e\" ]; then\n        echo \"📱 检测到 ARM64 架构，检查 sqlite3 模块...\"\n        \n        # 检查 sqlite3 是否需要重建\n        if [ -d \"node_modules/sqlite3\" ]; then\n            echo \"🔨 重建 sqlite3 模块以支持 ARM64...\"\n            npm rebuild sqlite3\n            if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then\n                echo \"⚠️  sqlite3 重建失败，尝试重新安装...\"\n                npm install sqlite3 --force\n            fi\n        fi\n        \n        # 检查 @jridgewell/sourcemap-codec 模块\n        if [ -d \"node_modules/@jridgewell/sourcemap-codec\" ]; then\n            if [ ! -f \"node_modules/@jridgewell/sourcemap-codec/dist/sourcemap-codec.umd.js\" ]; then\n                echo \"🔨 修复 @jridgewell/sourcemap-codec 模块...\"\n                npm install @jridgewell/sourcemap-codec --force\n            fi\n        fi\n    fi\n}\n\n# 获取脚本所在目录\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"${BASH_SOURCE[0]}\")\" &amp;&amp; pwd)\"",

        "contents": "/**\n * 批量删除乱码文件\n * DELETE /api/v1/ai-search/files/garbled/cleanup\n */\nrouter.delete('/files/garbled/cleanup', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    await initializeFileTable();\n\n    // 查找所有乱码文件\n    const sql = &#96;SELECT file_id FROM files WHERE status = 'active' AND (original_name LIKE '%ã€%' OR original_name LIKE '%ç¥%' OR original_name LIKE '%æ%')&#96;;\n    const garbledFiles = await db.query(sql);\n    \n    let deletedCount = 0;\n    for (const file of garbledFiles as any[]) {\n      const success = await fileService.deleteFile(file.file_id);\n      if (success) {\n        deletedCount++;\n      }\n    }\n\n    res.json(\n      formatApiResponse(true, { deletedCount }, &#96;成功删除 ${deletedCount} 个乱码文件&#96;)\n    );\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('批量删除乱码文件失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(\n      formatApiResponse(\n        false,\n        null,\n        '批量删除乱码文件失败',\n        error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n      )\n    );\n  }\n});\nrouter.get('/files/:fileId', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try\n}",

        },
        "contents": "/**\n * 与指定AI角色对话\n * POST /api/v1/ai-roles/:id/chat\n * 支持multipart/form-data（带文件）和application/json（不带文件）\n * 注意：必须在 /:id 路由之前定义，否则会被当作 id 处理\n */\nrouter.post('/:id/chat', upload.array('files', 10), async (req, res) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    const { id } = req.params;\n    \n    // 处理文件上传\n    const uploadedFiles = req.files as Express.Multer.File[];\n    let fileUrls: string[] = [];\n    \n    if (uploadedFiles &amp;&amp; uploadedFiles.length &gt; 0) {\n      // 保存文件到数据库并获取文件URL\n      const filePromises = uploadedFiles.map(async (file) =&gt; {\n        const filePath = file.path;\n        const fileUrl = &#96;/uploads/ai-roles/${file.filename}&#96;;\n        \n        // 确定文件分类\n        let category = 'general';\n        if (file.mimetype.startsWith('image/')) {\n          category = 'image';\n        } else if (file.mimetype.startsWith('application/pdf') || \n                   file.mimetype.includes('document') || \n                   file.mimetype.includes('word') ||\n                   file.mimetype.includes('text')) {\n          category = 'document';\n        }\n\n        // 处理文件名编码\n        let originalName = file.originalname;\n        try {\n          const hasGarbledChars = /ã€|ç¥|æ|Ã|â€|â€|â€/.test(originalName);\n          if (hasGarbledChars) {\n            const buffer = Buffer.from(originalName, 'latin1');\n            const decoded = buffer.toString('utf8');\n            if (/[\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/.test(decoded)) {\n              originalName = decoded;\n            }\n          }\n        } catch (e) {\n          // 忽略编码错误，使用原始文件名\n        }\n\n        // 保存文件记录到数据库\n        const fileRecord = await fileService.createFile\n;\n      };\n}",
