          }
        },
        "contents": "export class FileService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有文件列表\n   */\n  async getAllFiles(options?: {\n    category?: string;\n    status?: string;\n    conversationId?: string;\n    pageType?: string; // 页面类型：'tech-package' | 'press-release'\n    limit?: number;\n    offset?: number;\n    excludeGarbled?: boolean; // 排除乱码文件名\n  }): Promise&lt;FileRecord[]&gt; {\n    try {\n      let sql = &#96;SELECT * FROM files WHERE 1=1&#96;;\n      const params: any[] = [];\n\n      if (options?.category) {\n        sql += &#96; AND category = ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.category);\n      }\n\n      if (options?.status) {\n        sql += &#96; AND status = ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.status);\n      } else {\n        sql += &#96; AND status = 'active'&#96;;\n      }\n\n      if (options?.conversationId) {\n        sql += &#96; AND conversation_id = ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.conversationId);\n      }\n\n      // 按页面类型过滤（通过metadata字段）\n      if (options?.pageType) {\n        // 只返回metadata中包含指定pageType的文件\n        sql += &#96; AND metadata LIKE ?&#96;;\n        params.push(&#96;%\"pageType\":\"${options.pageType}\"%&#96;);\n      }\n      // 如果没有指定pageType，返回所有文件（包括没有metadata的旧文件）\n\n      // 排除乱码文件名\n      if (options?.excludeGarbled) {\n        sql += &#96; AND original_name NOT LIKE '%ã€%' AND original_name NOT LIKE '%ç¥%' AND original_name NOT LIKE '%æ%'&#96;;\n      }\n\n      sql += &#96; ORDER BY created_at DESC&#96;;\n\n      if (options?.limit) {\n        sql += &#96; LIMIT ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.limit);\n      }\n\n      if (options?.offset) {\n        sql += &#96; OFFSET ?&#96;;\n        params.push(options.offset);\n      }\n\n      const rows = await db.query(sql, params);\n      \n      // 基于文件哈希去重，只保留最新的记录\n      const fileMap = new Map&lt;string, FileRecord&gt;();\n      for (const row of rows as FileRecord[]) {\n        if (row.file_hash) {\n          const existing = fileMap.get(row.file_hash);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const loadFiles = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      try {\n        const cleanupApi = await import(\"../../services/api\");\n        await cleanupApi.default.delete('/ai-search/files/garbled/cleanup');\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn('清理乱码文件失败:', error);\n      }\n\n      // 使用有效的 pageType（可能包含项目ID）\n      const files = await aiSearchService.getFiles({ pageType: effectivePageType });\n      const fileSources: Source[] = files.map((file) =&gt; ({\n        id: &#96;file_${file.id || file.fileId}&#96;,\n        title: file.name,\n        type: 'external' as const,\n        url: file.url,\n        description: &#96;文件大小: ${formatFileSize(file.size)}&#96;,\n      }));\n      \n      setSources((prev) =&gt; {\n        const nonFileSources = prev.filter((s) =&gt; !s.id.startsWith('file_'));\n        return [...nonFileSources, ...fileSources];\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载文件列表失败:', error);\n    }\n  }, [effectivePageType]);\n\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&gt; {\n    if (bytes &lt; 1024) return bytes + ' B';\n    if (bytes &lt; 1024 * 1024) return (bytes / 1024).toFixed(1) + ' KB';\n    return (bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1) + ' MB';\n  };\n\n  const loadAvailableWorkflows = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      setIsWorkflowLoading(true);\n      const list = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\n      setAvailableWorkflows(list);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"加载工作流列表失败:\", error);\n      reportError(\"加载工作流列表失败\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\n    } finally {\n      setIsWorkflowLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [reportError]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadAvailableWorkflows();\n  }, [loadAvailableWorkflows]);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadEnabledToolsForPage = async () =&gt;\n;\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "// 生产环境静态文件服务：直接从 frontend/dist 提供资源\n// 注意：必须在 API 路由之后，否则会拦截 API 请求\n// 仅在非开发环境或明确需要时才启用静态文件服务\nconst isDev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production';\nif (!isDev) {\n  const distDir = path.join(__dirname, '../../frontend/dist');\n  app.use(express.static(distDir, {\n    maxAge: 0,\n    etag: true,\n    lastModified: true,\n  }));\n\n  // SPA Fallback：除 /api/* 外的所有路由都返回 index.html\n  app.get(/^(\\/(?!api).*)$/, (_req, res) =&gt; {\n    res.sendFile(path.join(distDir, 'index.html'));\n  });\n}\n\n// 全局错误处理中间件\n// 注意：这个中间件必须放在所有路由之后，且必须有4个参数 (err, req, res, next)\napp.use((err: any, req: any, res: any, next: any) =&gt; {\n  // 如果响应已经发送，则委托给默认的 Express 错误处理\n  if (res.headersSent) {\n    return next(err);\n  }\n\n  // 记录错误详情\n  logger.error('全局错误处理', {\n    error: err,\n    stack: err?.stack,\n    requestUrl: req.url,\n    originalUrl: req.originalUrl,\n    method: req.method,\n    path: req.path,\n    body: req.body,\n    params: req.params,\n    query: req.query,\n  });\n\n  // 发送到错误追踪\n  errorTracking.captureException(\n    err instanceof Error ? err : new Error(String(err)),\n    {\n      context: {\n        metadata: {\n          method: req.method,\n          path: req.path,\n          body: req.body,\n          params: req.params,\n          query: req.query,\n        },\n      },\n    }\n  );\n\n  // 根据错误类型返回不同的状态码\n  const statusCode = err.statusCode || err.status || 500;\n  const errorMessage =\n    process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'\n      ? '服务器内部错误'\n      : err.message || 'Unknown error';\n\n  res.status(statusCode).json({\n    success: false,\n    message: 'Internal server error',\n    error: errorMessage,\n    ...(process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' &amp;&amp; { stack: err?.stack }),\n  });\n});\n\n// 启动服务器前测试数据库连接\nasync function startServer() {\n  try\n}",

        "contents": "export class WorkflowEngine {\nprivate async executeInputNode(node: AgentWorkflowNode, workflowInput: any): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n\n      \n      // 如果是文件类型，处理文件\n      if (inputParam.type === 'file' &amp;&amp; value) {\n        // 如果是File对象，转换为base64或保存文件信息\n        if (value instanceof File) {\n          // 检查文件大小限制\n          if (inputParam.maxSize &amp;&amp; value.size &gt; inputParam.maxSize) {\n            throw new Error(&#96;文件 ${inputName} 大小超过限制 ${(inputParam.maxSize / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)}MB&#96;);\n          }\n          \n          // 检查文件类型\n          if (inputParam.accept) {\n            const accepts = inputParam.accept.split(',').map(a =&gt; a.trim());\n            const fileType = value.type || '';\n            const fileName = value.name || '';\n            const fileExt = fileName.includes('.') ? '.' + fileName.split('.').pop()?.toLowerCase() : '';\n            \n            const isValidType = accepts.some(accept =&gt; {\n              if (accept.startsWith('.')) {\n                return fileExt === accept || fileExt === accept.toLowerCase();\n              } else if (accept.includes('*')) {\n                const baseType = accept.split('/')[0];\n                return fileType.startsWith(baseType + '/');\n              } else {\n                return fileType === accept || fileExt === accept;\n              }\n            });\n            \n            if (!isValidType) {\n              throw new Error(&#96;文件 ${inputName} 类型不符合要求，需要: ${inputParam.accept}&#96;);\n            }\n          }\n          \n          // 将文件转换为base64（对于小文件）或保存文件信息\n          // 这里可以根据实际需求选择处理方式\n          value = {\n            name: value.name,\n            type: value.type,\n            size: value.size,\n            lastModified: value.lastModified,\n            // 如果需要，可以在这里读取文件内容为base64\n            // content: await this.fileToBase64(value),\n          };\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 将输入值保存到共享上下文\n      this.execution!.sharedContext[inputName] = value;\n      \n      results.push({\n        name: inputName,\n        value,\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import fs from 'fs';\nimport path from 'path';\nimport { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\n\n/**\n * 文件转Markdown服务\n * 将PDF、Word、PPT、TXT、Markdown等文件转换为Markdown格式\n */\nexport class FileToMarkdownService {\n  /**\n   * 将文件转换为Markdown格式\n   * @param filePath 文件路径\n   * @param mimeType 文件MIME类型\n   * @param originalName 原始文件名\n   * @returns Markdown格式的文本内容\n   */\n  async convertToMarkdown(\n    filePath: string,\n    mimeType: string,\n    originalName: string\n  ): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n    try {\n      const fileExtension = path.extname(originalName).toLowerCase();\n      \n      // 根据文件类型选择转换方法\n      if (mimeType === 'application/pdf' || fileExtension === '.pdf') {\n        return await this.convertPdfToMarkdown(filePath, originalName);\n      } else if (\n        mimeType === 'application/msword' ||\n        mimeType === 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document' ||\n        fileExtension === '.doc' ||\n        fileExtension === '.docx'\n      ) {\n        return await this.convertWordToMarkdown(filePath, originalName);\n      } else if (\n        mimeType === 'application/vnd.ms-powerpoint' ||\n        mimeType === 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation' ||\n        fileExtension === '.ppt' ||\n        fileExtension === '.pptx'\n      ) {\n        return await this.convertPptToMarkdown(filePath, originalName);\n      } else if (\n        mimeType === 'text/plain' ||\n        mimeType === 'text/markdown' ||\n        fileExtension === '.txt' ||\n        fileExtension === '.md' ||\n        fileExtension === '.markdown'\n      ) {\n        return await this.convertTextToMarkdown(filePath, originalName);\n      } else {\n        logger.warn('不支持的文件类型，返回空内容', { mimeType, fileExtension, originalName });\n        return &#96;# ${originalName}\\n\\n不支持的文件类型: ${mimeType}&#96;;\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('文件转Markdown失败', {\n        filePath,\n        mimeType,\n        originalName,\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n      });\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 转换PDF为Markdown\n   */\n  private async convertPdfToMarkdown(filePath: string, originalName: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class PublicKnowledgeService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 生成文件存储路径\n   */\n  generateFilePath(originalName: string): string {\n    const timestamp = Date.now();\n    const randomStr = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);\n    const ext = path.extname(originalName);\n    const baseName = path.basename(originalName, ext);\n    const sanitizedName = baseName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\\u4e00-\\u9fa5]/g, '_');\n    const fileName = &#96;${timestamp}-${randomStr}-${sanitizedName}${ext}&#96;;\n    return path.join(this.uploadDir, fileName);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 获取文件的相对URL路径\n   */\n  getFileUrl(filePath: string): string {\n    const relativePath = path.relative(path.join(process.cwd(), 'backend'), filePath);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class FileToMarkdownService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 转换文本文件为Markdown\n   */\n  private async convertTextToMarkdown(filePath: string, originalName: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n    try {\n      const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8');\n      const fileExtension = path.extname(originalName).toLowerCase();\n      \n      // 如果已经是markdown文件，直接返回\n      if (fileExtension === '.md' || fileExtension === '.markdown') {\n        return content;\n      }\n      \n      // 普通文本文件，添加标题\n      const markdown = &#96;# ${originalName}\\n\\n${content}&#96;;\n      logger.info('文本转Markdown成功', { originalName, textLength: content.length });\n      return markdown;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('文本转Markdown失败', {\n        filePath,\n        originalName,\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n      });\n      return &#96;# ${originalName}\\n\\n文本文件读取失败: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}&#96;;\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport const fileToMarkdownService = new FileToMarkdownService();",

        "contents": "export class SendMessageUseCase {\nprivate async buildConversationData(\n    params: {\n      conversation: any | null;\n      content: string;\n      sources?: any[];\n      files?: Express.Multer.File[];\n      contextWindowSize?: number;\n      workflowId?: string;\n      fileList?: string;\n      knowledgeBaseNames?: string;\n    }\n  ) {\n\n    if (params.files &amp;&amp; params.files.length &gt; 0) {\n      try {\n        // 通过文件名查找文件记录，获取markdown内容\n        for (const file of params.files) {\n          try {\n            // 通过原始文件名查找文件记录\n            const allFiles = await fileService.getAllFiles({\n              status: 'active',\n            });\n            const fileRecord = allFiles.find(\n              (f) =&gt; f.original_name === file.originalname || f.stored_name === file.filename\n            );\n            \n            if (fileRecord &amp;&amp; fileRecord.metadata) {\n              const metadata = typeof fileRecord.metadata === 'string' \n                ? JSON.parse(fileRecord.metadata) \n                : fileRecord.metadata;\n              \n              if (metadata.markdownContent) {\n                fileMarkdownContents.push(&#96;【${fileRecord.original_name}】\\n${metadata.markdownContent}&#96;);\n                logger.info('从文件记录中提取markdown内容', {\n                  fileName: fileRecord.original_name,\n                  markdownLength: metadata.markdownContent.length,\n                });\n              }\n            }\n          } catch (error) {\n            logger.warn('提取文件markdown内容失败', {\n              fileName: file.originalname,\n              error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n            });\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        logger.warn('批量提取文件markdown内容失败', {\n          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 判断是否是第一次对话（对话不存在或没有历史消息）\n    const isFirstMessage = !params.conversation || \n                          !params.conversation.messages || \n                          params.conversation.messages.length === 0;\n    \n    // 提取附加信息：外部来源的文本内容和文件的markdown内容\n    let additionalContext = '';\n    \n    const textContents: string[] = [];\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 获取文件列表\n * GET /api/v1/ai-search/files?pageType=tech-package|press-release\n */\nrouter.get('/files', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    await initializeFileTable();\n\n    const category = req.query.category as string | undefined;\n    const conversationId = req.query.conversationId as string | undefined;\n    const pageType = req.query.pageType as string | undefined; // 'tech-package' | 'press-release'\n    const limit = req.query.limit ? parseInt(req.query.limit as string, 10) : undefined;\n    const offset = req.query.offset ? parseInt(req.query.offset as string, 10) : undefined;\n    const excludeGarbled = req.query.excludeGarbled !== 'false'; // 默认排除乱码文件名\n\n    const files = await fileService.getAllFiles({\n      category,\n      conversationId,\n      pageType,\n      limit,\n      offset,\n      excludeGarbled, // 默认排除乱码文件名\n    });\n\n    const fileList = files.map((file) =&gt; ({\n      id: file.file_id,\n      fileId: file.file_id,\n      name: file.original_name,\n      url: file.file_url,\n      type: file.mime_type,\n      size: file.file_size,\n      category: file.category,\n      tags: file.tags ? JSON.parse(file.tags) : [],\n      description: file.description,\n      usageCount: file.usage_count,\n      lastUsedAt: file.last_used_at,\n      createdAt: file.created_at,\n      updatedAt: file.updated_at,\n    }));\n\n    res.json(\n      formatApiResponse(true, fileList, '获取文件列表成功')\n    );\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(\n      formatApiResponse(\n        false,\n        null,\n        '获取文件列表失败',\n        error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n      )\n    );\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 删除文件（软删除）\n * DELETE /api/v1/ai-search/files/:fileId\n */",

        },
        "contents": "export class WorkflowEngine {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 执行输出节点\n   */\n  private async executeOutputNode(node: AgentWorkflowNode, workflow: AgentWorkflow): Promise&lt;any&gt; {\n    const data = node.data as any;\n    const outputs = data.outputs || [];\n    \n    const results: any[] = [];\n    \n    for (const outputParam of outputs) {\n      const outputName = outputParam.name || 'output';\n      \n      let outputValue: any;\n      \n      // 如果有指定的源节点，从该节点获取输出\n      if (outputParam.sourceNodeId) {\n        const sourceOutput = this.execution?.sharedContext.nodeOutputs?.[outputParam.sourceNodeId];\n        \n        if (sourceOutput === undefined) {\n          throw new Error(&#96;源节点 ${outputParam.sourceNodeId} 的输出不存在&#96;);\n        }\n        \n        // 如果指定了字段，提取该字段\n        if (outputParam.sourceField) {\n          const fieldPath = outputParam.sourceField.split('.');\n          outputValue = fieldPath.reduce((obj, key) =&gt; obj?.[key], sourceOutput);\n        } else {\n          outputValue = sourceOutput;\n        }\n      } else {\n        // 如果没有指定源节点，使用共享上下文\n        outputValue = this.execution?.sharedContext;\n      }\n      \n      // 如果是文件类型，处理文件输出\n      if (outputParam.type === 'file' &amp;&amp; outputValue) {\n        // 如果outputValue是文件信息对象，添加下载信息\n        if (typeof outputValue === 'object' &amp;&amp; outputValue.name) {\n          outputValue = {\n            ...outputValue,\n            downloadFileName: outputParam.downloadFileName || outputValue.name,\n            downloadUrl: outputValue.url || outputValue.path, // 根据实际存储方式调整\n          };\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 将输出保存到共享上下文的 outputs 字段\n      if (!this.execution!.sharedContext.outputs) {\n        this.execution!.sharedContext.outputs = {};\n      }\n      this.execution!.sharedContext.outputs[outputName] = outputValue;\n      \n      results.push({\n        name: outputName,\n        value: outputValue\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "        fi\n    fi\n}\n\n# 获取脚本所在目录\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"${BASH_SOURCE[0]}\")\" &amp;&amp; pwd)\"\n\n# 安装后端依赖\ninstall_dependencies \"$SCRIPT_DIR/backend\" \"后端\"\n\n# 修复后端依赖兼容性问题\nfix_backend_dependencies \"$SCRIPT_DIR/backend\"\n\n# 检查后端 .env 文件\nif [ ! -f \"$SCRIPT_DIR/backend/.env\" ]; then\n    echo \"⚠️  警告: 后端 .env 文件不存在\"\n    echo \"   创建默认 .env 文件...\"\n    cat &gt; \"$SCRIPT_DIR/backend/.env\" &lt;&lt; EOF\n# 服务器端口配置\nPORT=3003\n\n# 数据库配置\nDB_TYPE=sqlite\nSQLITE_DB_PATH=./data/todify2.db\n\n# 服务器配置\nNODE_ENV=development\nEOF\n    echo \"✅ 已创建默认 .env 文件，请根据需要修改配置\"\nfi\n\n# 安装前端依赖\ninstall_dependencies \"$SCRIPT_DIR/frontend\" \"前端\"\n\n# 检查前端是否缺少 reactflow\nif [ ! -d \"$SCRIPT_DIR/frontend/node_modules/reactflow\" ]; then\n    echo \"📥 安装缺失的 reactflow 依赖...\"\n    cd \"$SCRIPT_DIR/frontend\"\n    npm install reactflow\nfi\n\necho \"🎯 启动服务...\"\n\n# 启动后端服务\necho \"🔧 启动后端服务 (端口: $BACKEND_PORT)...\"\ncd \"$SCRIPT_DIR/backend\"\n\n# 确保数据库目录存在\nif [ -f \".env\" ]; then\n    # 从 .env 文件中读取数据库路径\n    DB_PATH=$(grep \"^SQLITE_DB_PATH=\" .env | cut -d '=' -f2 | tr -d '\"' | tr -d \"'\" | xargs || echo \"./data/todify2.db\")\n    # 如果路径是相对路径，确保相对于 backend 目录\n    if [[ \"$DB_PATH\" != /* ]]; then\n        DB_PATH=\"$SCRIPT_DIR/backend/$DB_PATH\"\n    fi\n    DB_DIR=$(dirname \"$DB_PATH\")\n    if [ ! -d \"$DB_DIR\" ]; then\n        echo \"📁 创建数据库目录: $DB_DIR\"\n        mkdir -p \"$DB_DIR\"\n    fi\n    echo \"📂 数据库路径: $DB_PATH\"\nfi\n\n# 确保日志文件存在\nBACKEND_LOG=\"/tmp/backend.log\"\ntouch \"$BACKEND_LOG\"\n\n# 清理旧的日志文件\n&gt; \"$BACKEND_LOG\"\n\n# 检查必要的依赖\necho \"🔍 检查后端依赖...\"\nif [ ! -d \"node_modules\" ]; then\n    echo \"❌ 后端依赖未安装，请先运行 npm install\"\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# 检查 TypeScript 编译工具\nif ! command -v ts-node-dev &amp;&gt; /dev/null &amp;&amp; [ ! -f \"node_modules/.bin/ts-node-dev\" ]; then\n    ",

        "contents": "export class FileToMarkdownService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 转换Word为Markdown\n   */\n  private async convertWordToMarkdown(filePath: string, originalName: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 尝试使用mammoth库\n      let mammoth: any;\n      try {\n        const mammothModule = require('mammoth');\n        // mammoth可能是默认导出或命名导出\n        mammoth = mammothModule.default || mammothModule;\n        \n        // 检查是否有extractRawText方法\n        if (!mammoth || typeof mammoth.extractRawText !== 'function') {\n          throw new Error('mammoth.extractRawText 不是一个函数');\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        logger.warn('mammoth库未安装或导入失败', { originalName, error: e });\n        return &#96;# ${originalName}\\n\\nWord文件内容提取需要安装mammoth库。\\n请运行: npm install mammoth&#96;;\n      }\n\n      const result = await mammoth.extractRawText({ path: filePath });\n      const markdown = &#96;# ${originalName}\\n\\n${result.value || ''}&#96;;\n      logger.info('Word转Markdown成功', { originalName, textLength: result.value?.length || 0 });\n      return markdown;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('Word转Markdown失败', {\n        filePath,\n        originalName,\n        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),\n      });\n      return &#96;# ${originalName}\\n\\nWord文件解析失败: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}&#96;;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 转换PPT为Markdown\n   */\n  private async convertPptToMarkdown(filePath: string, originalName: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n    \n  }\n}",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./backend/src/modules/ai-search/api/aiSearch.routes.ts",

        "contents": "// 配置multer用于文件上传\nconst storage = multer.diskStorage({\n  destination: (req, file, cb) =&gt; {\n    cb(null, 'uploads/ai-search/');\n  },\n  filename: (req, file, cb) =&gt; {\n    // 生成唯一文件名，但保留原始扩展名\n    const uniqueSuffix = Date.now() + '-' + Math.round(Math.random() * 1E9);\n    const ext = path.extname(file.originalname);\n    cb(null, &#96;${uniqueSuffix}${ext}&#96;);\n  },\n});\n\nconst upload = multer({\n  storage: storage,\n  limits: {\n    fileSize: 10 * 1024 * 1024, // 10MB\n  },\n  fileFilter: (req: Request, file: Express.Multer.File, cb: multer.FileFilterCallback) =&gt; {\n    // 允许的文件类型：PDF, PPT, txt, markdown, word\n    const allowedTypes = [\n      'application/pdf',\n      'application/vnd.ms-powerpoint', // .ppt\n      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation', // .pptx\n      'application/msword', // .doc\n      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document', // .docx\n      'text/plain',\n      'text/markdown',\n    ];\n    // 也允许通过扩展名判断\n    const allowedExtensions = ['.pdf', '.ppt', '.pptx', '.doc', '.docx', '.txt', '.md', '.markdown'];\n    const fileExtension = require('path').extname(file.originalname).toLowerCase();\n    \n    if (allowedTypes.includes(file.mimetype) || allowedExtensions.includes(fileExtension)) {\n      cb(null, true);\n    } else {\n      cb(new Error(&#96;不支持的文件类型: ${file.mimetype}。支持的类型：PDF, PPT, txt, markdown, word&#96;));\n    }\n  },\n});\n\n// 确保上传目录存在\nconst uploadDir = 'uploads/ai-search/';\nif (!fs.existsSync(uploadDir)) {\n  fs.mkdirSync(uploadDir, { recursive: true });\n}\n\n// 初始化服务\nconst aiSearchService = new AiSearchService();\nconst fieldMappingService = new FieldMappingService();\nconst createConversationUseCase = new CreateConversationUseCase(aiSearchService);\nconst getConversationsUseCase = new GetConversationsUseCase(aiSearchService);\nconst getConversationDetailUseCase = new GetConversationDetailUseCase(aiSearchService);\nconst sendMessageUseCase = new SendMessageUseCase;",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

`【` 的 UTF-8 编码是 `0xe3 0x80 0x90`，按 Latin-1 读取会变成 `ã`。乱码 `ã【final】` 表明部分字符被错误编码。改进修复逻辑，处理混合编码情况：

## 乱码原因分析

### 问题根源
1. 上传时编码错误：浏览器上传包含中文的文件名时，multer 将 UTF-8 编码的文件名误读为 Latin-1（ISO-8859-1），导致乱码。
2. 数据库存储乱码：错误编码的文件名被直接存入数据库。
3. 显示时未修复：虽然已添加修复逻辑，但数据库中已有的乱码数据需要修复。

### 具体乱码示例
- 原始文件名：`【final】吉利发布行业首个AI座舱.pdf`
- 错误编码后：`ã【final】å©å¸ä¸é¦ä¸ªAIåº§è.pdf`
- 原因：UTF-8 字节序列被按 Latin-1 解释

## 已实施的解决方案

### 1. 后端编码修复逻辑（已改进）
- 扩展乱码检测：包含 `ã`、`å`、`ä`、`è`、`ç`、`æ` 等
- 修复策略：将 Latin-1 编码的字符串转换为 UTF-8
- 验证机制：检查是否包含中文字符或可读性是否提升

### 2. 前端编码修复（双重保障）
- 在 `FileList` 组件中添加编码修复函数
- 显示文件名时自动修复
- 下载时也使用修复后的文件名

### 3. 数据迁移脚本
- 创建了 `fix-garbled-filenames.ts` 脚本
- 可批量修复数据库中已存在的乱码文件名

## 使用方法

### 修复已存在的乱码数据
运行数据迁移脚本：
```bash
cd backend
npx ts-node src/scripts/fix-garbled-filenames.ts
```

### 新上传的文件
- 上传时自动修复编码
- 显示时自动修复（前端双重保障）
- 下载时使用修复后的文件名

## 建议
1. 运行数据迁移脚本修复现有乱码数据
2. 测试新上传的文件，确认编码正确
3. 如仍有问题，检查数据库字符集设置

现在系统已具备：
- 上传时自动修复编码
- 读取时自动修复编码（后端 + 前端双重保障）
- 批量修复已存在乱码数据的脚本

请运行数据迁移脚本修复现有数据，然后测试新上传的文件。

        "contents": "export class PublicKnowledgeService {\nasync deleteCategory(id: number): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n {\n      // 获取所有子分类\n      const children = await publicKnowledgeModel.getCategoriesByParentId(id);\n      \n      // 递归删除子分类\n      for (const child of children) {\n        await this.deleteCategory(child.id);\n      }\n\n      // 获取分类下的所有文件并删除\n      const files = await publicKnowledgeModel.getFilesByCategoryId(id);\n      for (const file of files) {\n        await this.deleteFileWithPhysicalFile(file.id);\n      }\n\n      // 删除分类本身\n      await publicKnowledgeModel.deleteCategory(id);\n      \n      logger.info('分类删除成功', { categoryId: id });\n      return true;\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('删除分类失败:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * 获取文件列表\n * GET /api/v1/ai-search/files?pageType=tech-package|press-release\n */\nrouter.get('/files', async (req: Request, res: Response) =&gt; {\n  try {\n    await initializeFileTable();\n\n    const category = req.query.category as string | undefined;\n    const conversationId = req.query.conversationId as string | undefined;\n    const pageType = req.query.pageType as string | undefined; // 'tech-package' | 'press-release'\n    const limit = req.query.limit ? parseInt(req.query.limit as string, 10) : undefined;\n    const offset = req.query.offset ? parseInt(req.query.offset as string, 10) : undefined;\n    const excludeGarbled = req.query.excludeGarbled !== 'false'; // 默认排除乱码文件名\n\n    const files = await fileService.getAllFiles({\n      category,\n      conversationId,\n      pageType,\n      limit,\n      offset,\n      excludeGarbled, // 默认排除乱码文件名\n    });\n\n    const fileList = files.map((file) =&gt; ({\n      id: file.file_id,\n      fileId: file.file_id,\n      name: file.original_name,\n      url: file.file_url,\n      type: file.mime_type,\n      size: file.file_size,\n      category: file.category,\n      tags: file.tags ? JSON.parse(file.tags) : [],\n      description: file.description,\n      usageCount: file.usage_count,\n      lastUsedAt: file.last_used_at,\n      createdAt: file.created_at,\n      updatedAt: file.updated_at,\n    }));\n\n    res.json(\n      formatApiResponse(true, fileList, '获取文件列表成功')\n    );\n  } catch (error) {\n    logger.error('获取文件列表失败:', error);\n    res.status(500).json(\n      formatApiResponse(\n        false,\n        null,\n        '获取文件列表失败',\n        error instanceof Error ? error.message : '未知错误'\n      )\n    );\n  }\n});\n\n/**\n * 删除文件（软删除）\n * DELETE /api/v1/ai-search/files/:fileId\n */",

        "contents": "export class PublicKnowledgeModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取所有文件\n   */\n  async getAllFiles(categoryId?: number | null): Promise&lt;PublicKnowledgeFile[]&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    const dbType = this.db.getType();\n    let sql = 'SELECT * FROM public_knowledge_files';\n    const values: any[] = [];\n\n    if (categoryId !== undefined) {\n      if (categoryId === null) {\n        sql += dbType === 'sqlite' ?         "contents": "const ProjectResourcesPage: React.FC = \nconst autoSaveConversationSummaryWithMessages = async \n\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响用户体验\n    }\n  };\n\n  const loadPublicKnowledgeFiles = async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const response = await publicKnowledgeService.getFiles();\n      if (response.success &amp;&amp; response.data) {\n        setPublicKnowledgeFiles(response.data);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载公共知识库文件失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 更新已配置的资源清单\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // 区分文件来源和互联网信息点\n    // 文件来源：通过文件上传功能上传的文件（URL是文件路径，不是http链接）\n    // 互联网信息点：来自\"检索信息\"模块的来源（排除上传的文件，只包含http/https链接或没有URL的文本来源）\n    const files = sources.filter(s =&gt; {\n      // 文件上传的通常URL是文件路径，不是http链接\n      // 检查：type为external，且有url，且url不是http/https开头\n      // 文件URL特征：以/uploads/开头，或者包含文件扩展名（.pdf, .doc等）\n      \n      // 首先检查type\n      if (s.type !== 'external') {\n        return false;\n      }\n      \n      // 检查URL是否存在\n      const hasUrl = s.url &amp;&amp; (typeof s.url === 'string' || typeof s.url === 'object');\n      if (!hasUrl) {\n        console.log('[资源清单] ✗ 未识别为文件（无URL）:', { \n          id: s.id, \n          title: s.title, \n          type: s.type,\n          url: s.url,\n          urlType: typeof s.url\n        });\n        return false;\n      }\n      \n      // 处理URL（可能是字符串或对象）\n      let urlStr: string;\n      if (typeof s.url === 'string') {\n        urlStr = s.url.trim();\n      } else if (s.url &amp;&amp; typeof s.url === 'object' &amp;&amp; 'toString' in s.url) {\n        urlStr = String(s.url).trim();\n      } else {\n        console.log('[资源清单] ✗ 未识别为文件（URL格式异常）:', { \n          id: s.id, \n          title: s.title, \n          type: s.type,\n          url: s.url,\n          urlType: typeof s.url\n        });\n        return false;\n      }\n      \n      if (urlStr.length === 0) {\n        return false;\n      }\n    };\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "const FileList: React.FC&lt;FileListProps&gt; = \nconst fixFileNameEncoding = \n\n    }\n    return fileName;\n  };\n\n  const formatFileSize = (bytes: number): string =&gt; {\n    if (bytes === 0) return '0 B';\n    const k = 1024;\n    const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];\n    const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));\n    return Math.round(bytes / Math.pow(k, i) * 100) / 100 + ' ' + sizes[i];\n  };\n\n  const getFileIcon = (fileType: string) =&gt; {\n    if (fileType.startsWith('image/')) {\n      return '🖼️';\n    } else if (fileType.includes('pdf')) {\n      return '📄';\n    } else if (fileType.includes('word') || fileType.includes('document')) {\n      return '📝';\n    } else if (fileType.includes('excel') || fileType.includes('spreadsheet')) {\n      return '📊';\n    } else if (fileType.includes('powerpoint') || fileType.includes('presentation')) {\n      return '📽️';\n    } else if (fileType.includes('zip') || fileType.includes('rar')) {\n      return '📦';\n    } else {\n      return '📎';\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDownload = async (file: PublicKnowledgeFile) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const blob = await publicKnowledgeService.downloadFile(file.id);\n      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n      const a = document.createElement('a');\n      a.href = url;\n      a.download = fixFileNameEncoding(file.name);\n      document.body.appendChild(a);\n      a.click();\n      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n      document.body.removeChild(a);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('下载文件失败:', error);\n      alert('下载文件失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handlePreview = (file: PublicKnowledgeFile) =&gt; {\n    const fileUrl = publicKnowledgeService.getFileUrl(file);\n    if (file.file_type.startsWith('image/')) {\n      setPreviewFile(file);\n    } else {\n      window.open(fileUrl, '_blank');\n    }\n  };\n\n  if (loading) {\n    return (\n      &lt;div className=\"bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200 p-8\"&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"text-center text-gray-500\"&gt;加载中...&lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\n;",
